description: This file manages wall marks (such as bullet holes or paint marks) in the game, including their creation, rendering, and lifecycle management. It defines functions for initializing, allocating, freeing, and rendering mark polygons, as well as registering new marks with specific properties.

classes.name: mark_t
classes.description: Structure representing a wall mark with properties like shader, position, direction, color, transparency, and size.

methods.name: CG_InitMarkPolys
methods.description: Initializes the mark polygons system at startup or restart.

methods.name: CG_FreeMarkPoly
methods.description: Removes a mark polygon from active list and adds it to free list.

methods.name: CG_AllocMarkPoly
methods.description: Allocates a new mark polygon, freeing the oldest if necessary.

methods.name: CG_ProcessMarks
methods.description: Processes new marks, creates polygons, and batches fragments for rendering.

methods.name: CG_RegisterMark
methods.description: Registers a new mark with specified properties to be rendered.

methods.name: CG_AddMarkPolys
methods.description: Adds active mark polygons to the scene, handling fading and removal over time.
